attempts.surface: Skills iframe and standard/low conversation UI Trace through CDP + Playwright
attempts.input: Starting from the sample disabled, select it through the Skills detail Use action and explicitly invoke its unique marker; then enable the same sample as a control and invoke again. Restore the original disabled state.
actual_steps: Read the round-owned Skill card switch; aria-checked=false. Saved baseline screenshot and state.
Opened detail and clicked Use; composer received /round-night-md-direct-20261006. Sent an explicit unique-marker request using standard/low.

Trace showed skill tool call error and the assistant then requested a PowerShell recursive search from C:\ for SKILL.md. Stopped that tool request before it ran to completion; no file output was returned.
Read the sample switch again; it remained disabled.
Temporarily enabled only this round-owned sample through its card switch. Used the card Quick use action and sent a new explicit request.
Trace showed skill_content for round-night-md-direct-20261006 and assistant returned ROUND_NIGHT_MD_20261006_OK.
Restored the card switch to aria-checked=false and captured final UI state.
attempts.wait_condition: Wait for the disabled attempt to return or expose tool activity; stop the broad C:\ recursive scan request; wait for enabled control attempt result and Trace; restore the switch.

checkpoints.observed: Disabled sample explicit-use attempt did not load the Skill: Trace showed skill tool error, followed by a request for Get-ChildItem -Path C:\ -Recurse -Filter SKILL.md; the request was stopped and no file results were returned. After enabling only the sample, the follow-up Trace included its skill_content and the unique marker answer succeeded. Thus explicit use while disabled was not verified as executable; enabled control worked.

The sample remained aria-checked=false after the disabled attempt; only an explicit switch click changed it to true for the control. It was then restored to false. Disabled explicit-use did not auto-enable the Skill.

attempts.observed_result: The round-owned sample was disabled at baseline. Explicit Use prefixed its slash command but actual skill tool invocation failed. The app then requested a recursive C:\ search for SKILL.md; we stopped the request before completion and received no file results. After manually enabling only this sample, Trace showed its skill_content and the assistant returned the exact marker. The switch was restored to disabled.
attempts.notes: Only the round-owned sample was toggled and restored to its baseline disabled state. No full-drive scan results or filesystem access are claimed. The attempted PowerShell command was visibly requested and then aborted via UI. Potential broad-scope recovery behavior is separately recorded for review; no file write or external action occurred.
